milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the magenta wall banner (placed at spawn-relative [8, 2, 6] on the north-facing wall of the stone brick building) and be looking approximately toward it. max_distance=5 ensures the player is close enough to clearly see the banner, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are actually looking at it rather than facing away.
